basis: Event figure, Aquarius Ascendant: Asc lord Saturn peregrine in fall in 2nd; Moon in detriment applying square Mars (lord 2nd/9th); Cauda Draconis in Ascendant; Fortune disposed by Mercury lord of 7th (enemies). All testimonies debilitated and fortune to enemies = unsuccessful, dishonourable issue.
prediction_text: No success or honour from this last western expedition; it ends in loss and dishonour. Saturn, lord of the Aquarius Ascendant, is peregrine and in his fall in the second (his substance wasted), the Moon is in her detriment and applies to a square of Mars, lord of his second and ninth, and the Dragon's Tail is in the Ascendant. The Part of Fortune is disposed by Mercury, lord of the seventh, a significator of his enemies, so fortune passes to the enemy side: his money, assistants and journey fail him, and the issue is defeat/diminution of honour rather than victory.
timing: Month scale (campaign scale): the ill issue falls within this same western campaign, in the months immediately following the setting forth in 1644
